newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen steady in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen steady in active trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange are expected to be steady when trading opens on Monday, brokers said.
"The market is likely to remain steady in active trade," said broker Khurshid Alam.
He said market sentiment would be generally positive, although there was no news that could help the current rally.
However, other brokers said blue chips that had gained over the past several sessions might fall marginally on profit-taking.
On Sunday, the DSE all-share price index rose 1.28 points or 0.1 percent to 1,228.3 on turnover of 99.3 million taka. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
